fact: IPOA's report for July-December 2022, in which it inspected 97 police facilities, found the Occurrence Book maintained in 98% of the facilities followed up, the cell register in 77% and computers available in 42% (up from 38%, an improvement it attributes to the automated OB in some stations), and states that because official police registers, OBs included, were in insufficient supply most officers in charge had resorted to improvised registers, four-quire black books.
title: IPOA Performance Report July - December 2022
